evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: we talked to a lot of people everyday and most of them have one or two concerns either the movers not showing up on time, or damage to their items are either of those a concern for you
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'Have you guys damaging my items or?' and rep pivoted to 'Like, have you experienced that in the past? You know, either the movers not showing. Okay. Alright, great to hear that' — no second layer dig or silence held
evidence_quotes.value_days: No value days discussion; no mention of date flexibility or cost savings
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep gave price ($775 for 2.5 hours minimum) but never asked for the business, never mentioned rate lock, never attempted a close

top_strength: Jevic asked the two-concerns question early and before any logistics probing, hitting the v4 primary opener cleanly.
coaching_note: The call ended without ever asking for the business—after giving the estimate, the customer said 'Have a great day' and Jevic said goodbye with no attempt to close, confirm booking, or lock the rate. This abandons steps 5–7 entirely and leaves money on the table.
